title: Divergence: thermite-spec validator::check_match_exhaustiveness misses a guarded-only catch-all match over an enum (REQ-3 a guard does NOT complete a match)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-spec/tests/divergence_c10_guarded_catchall.rs::divergence_guarded_only_catchall_is_non_exhaustive demonstrates the divergence. ROOT CAUSE: check_match_exhaustiveness identifies the matched enum only via variant_pattern_name over arms; a match whose sole arm is a guarded catch-all (_ if cond) over an enum names no variant, so matched_enum is None and the function returns early with no exhaustiveness check. Per REQ-3/AC-3b a guard does NOT complete a match, so this should be NonExhaustiveMatch. Verus backstops it end-to-end (lowered match is E0004 -> forge L0), so it is NOT an L3-laundering hole, only a validator-completeness gap (opaque verus L0 instead of a structured NonExhaustiveMatch). Test is #[ignore]d (verus backstops; not a release blocker).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIX PLAN (acto-fixer, blocker #120): single-file fix in thermite-spec/src/validator.rs, fn check_match_exhaustiveness. ROOT CAUSE: the matched enum is inferred only from an arm naming a declared variant (variant_pattern_name); a guarded-only/catch-all-only match names none, so matched_enum is None and the fn returns Ok(()) with no check. FIX: in the matched_enum-None branch, when the match has arms AND every arm is guarded (arm.guard.is_some()), no arm completes the match unconditionally -> push SpecError::NonExhaustiveMatch. The scrutinee-type approach is unavailable (untyped AST, OQ-3); the all-arms-guarded fallback is the sound reject the design (11-ergonomics REQ-3/AC-3b) sanctions. DISTINCTION preserved: unguarded _ catch-all stays accepted (exhaustive); slice/Option/integer matches with unguarded arms stay inert. Un-ignore the pin after green gauntlet.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED in 7aa7ae5 (single file, thermite-spec/src/validator.rs, fn check_match_exhaustiveness). The matched_enum-None branch now rejects a match whose every arm is guarded (and which has >=1 arm) with SpecError::NonExhaustiveMatch — a guarded catch-all _ if cond => 0 over an enum names no variant (so the enum is unidentifiable) yet completes nothing (the guard may fail), per 11-ergonomics REQ-3/AC-3b. Approach: all-arms-guarded fallback (the scrutinee-type route is unavailable — the validator AST is untyped, OQ-3). DISTINCTION verified: unguarded _ catch-all stays ACCEPTED (not all-guarded -> exhaustive, no over-reject); guarded-only catch-all -> NonExhaustive; mixed guarded+unguarded and slice/Option/integer matches UNCHANGED (still inferred from variant-naming arms or left inert). Pin un-ignored. GAUNTLET: cargo build --workspace OK; cargo test --workspace 647 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt --all --check PASS. Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
